subject: [PATCH v4 3/7] sched/numa: scan read-only file mappings in tiering mode

2026-09-30.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NUMA balancing code to scan read-only file mappings when tiering is enabled, but only performs promotion scans on these mappings. This change allows hot file folios on slow memory to be promoted to faster memory, preventing them from getting stuck in slower memory. The patch also retains the existing restriction of excluding shared libraries from migration. With this change, binary tier residency can track runtime hotness more accurately.
